title: Closed support triangle adds one to the Tor upper bound
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion of schemes with complementary open immersion $j:V\hookrightarrow T$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small étale sites and their derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $i^\times$ be right adjoint to $i_*$, as in [lem-exc-closed-ambient], and suppose $i_*$ and $i^*$ are exact and the counit $i^*i_*\to\mathrm{id}$ is an isomorphism. Let $a\le b$ be integers, $e\ge0$ an integer, and $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ have Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Put $Q=Rj_*j^*K$ and suppose that $Q$ has Tor amplitude $[a,b+e]$ and that
$$ i_*i^\times K\longrightarrow K\longrightarrow Q\longrightarrow(i_*i^\times K)[1] $$
is the distinguished closed-support triangle. Then $i^\times K$ has Tor amplitude $[a,b+e+1]$ on $Z$.

source.place: Step 3, support triangle and long-exact-sequence argument giving the extra +1 in the upper Tor endpoint.
